# 0047 — Card illustrations generated by Gemini, one creature per card, reviewed by the owner

- **Date**: 2026-10-25
- **Status**: Accepted
- **Completes**: [0015](0015-illustrations-statiques-optimisees.md) (illustration pipeline), which cited Recraft as the
  starting lead

## Context

US-016 was to settle the tool for generating the illustrations of the 71 cards of set 1 (EPIC-05): Recraft was the
starting lead. The project budget is almost nil (ADR 0021) and the project owner has a Gemini (Google) subscription
for personal use. A trial on three cards (2026-10-24) showed that an overly precise common prompt ("same framing as
the reference image") produced almost identical images, with only the colour changing.

## Decision

- **Tool**: Gemini, in its web application, with the project owner's account, driven from their browser by the Claude
  in Chrome extension. No extra cost; the daily image-generation quotas set the pace (several days for 71 cards).
- **Prompt**: a distinct creature per card (silhouette, posture and setting drawn from what the card represents),
  described in French for review and in English for Gemini, in `docs/produit/prompts-illustrations-gemini.md`. A
  reference image (SFTP) fixes **only the rendering**: line, soft cel shading, light, midnight-blue background, family
  palette, intensity according to rarity.
- **Check**: each image is looked at before being kept (no text, logo or real person; creature clearly distinct); a
  check sheet per family is validated by the project owner before merging.
- **Originals**: 2400 × 1792 JPEGs archived outside the repository (ADR 0015), scaled down by
  `npm run illustrations`.
- **Prompts and data**: the prompts contain only public catalogue information (ADR 0022); no internal or personal data
  is sent to Gemini.

## Alternatives considered

- **Recraft**: a good tool for a constant style, but one more subscription for a personal project.
- **Generation by API** (Imagen, other): can be automated, but paid per image and with no natural review.
- **Provisional vector illustrations** (ADR 0016): free and deterministic, but too schematic to be appealing; they
  remain the fallback for a new card while waiting for its image.

## Consequences

- The 71 cards of set 1 have a distinct illustration (US-017); new cards (US-077, set 2) will follow the same
  pipeline and the same rule.
- Generation depends on a personal account and its quotas: it is not reproducible identically, hence the archiving of
  the originals and the prompts.
- Gemini's terms of use apply to the images; the game is a non-commercial internal project.
